questions.passage: Some researchers even claimed to have found different epigenetic patterns between hedonic and eudaimonic well-being, suggesting that our very genes are expressed differently. However, other researchers found that almost all people who say they are happy tend to also say that their lives are meaningful, and vice versa. The overlap between hedonic and eudaimonic well-being is so great that some researchers argue that they are virtually the same thing. Others argue that both happiness and meaning in life are so important that there is no point debating which is more important.
questions.prompt: What is the best summary of the debate described in this paragraph?
options: Researchers unanimously deny that happiness and meaning overlap.
Findings and interpretations differ about the distinction and overlap between happiness and meaning.
The debate has established epigenetic differences beyond dispute.
Every study shows that breaks are more meaningful than work.
analyses: A 后半段正强调 overlap，unanimously 与文本相反。
B 总结不同发现与解释，而不偏取一方。
C Some researchers even claimed 后还有对立发现，不是 beyond dispute。
D 更快乐与更投入是不同维度，且 every study 过度绝对。

evidence.quote: However, other researchers found that almost all people who say they are happy tend to also say that their lives are meaningful, and vice versa.

questions.translation: 一些研究者甚至声称，在享乐型与实现型幸福感之间发现了不同的表观遗传模式，暗示连基因表达都不相同。然而，其他研究者发现，几乎所有说自己幸福的人，也倾向于认为人生有意义，反之亦然。两类幸福感的重叠如此之大，以至于有些研究者认为它们实际上是同一件事。另一些人则认为，幸福与人生意义都非常重要，没有必要争论谁更重要。

questions.prompt: What idea is expressed by “You can get better!”?
options: Improvement is possible only outside school.
A person’s present skill level can never change.
A person can develop abilities rather than remain at the current level.
Learning about a mindset guarantees immediate expert performance.
questions.promptZh: “You can get better!”表达了什么想法？
optionsZh: 只有在校外才可能进步。
一个人当前的技能水平永远不能改变。

B can get better 与永不能改变相反。
C 保留 can 的可能性，准确改写能力可发展的意思。
D can 不是保证，get better 也不是立刻成为专家。
